nodes.title: Your Privacy Choices
nodes.body:
As described in our Privacy Policy, we collect personal information from your interactions with us and our website, including through cookies and similar technologies. We may also share this personal information with third parties, including advertising partners. We do this in order to show you ads on other websites that are more relevant to your interests and for other reasons outlined in our privacy policy.

Sharing of personal information for targeted advertising based on your interaction on different websites may be considered "sales", "sharing", or "targeted advertising" under certain U.S. state privacy laws. Depending on where you live, you may have the right to opt out of these activities. If you would like to exercise this opt-out right, please follow the instructions below.

If you visit our website with the Global Privacy Control opt-out preference signal enabled, depending on where you are, we will treat this as a request to opt-out of activity that may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information or other uses that may be considered targeted advertising for the device and browser you used to visit our website.

nodes.title: About Us
nodes.body:
Our Story

We started Wired & Warped because we looked at our phones—the one thing we hold for hours every single day—and realized they all looked exactly the same. Safe, clinical, and completely uninspired.

We don't think you should have to choose between keeping your tech safe and expressing your personal style. Your phone case should match your mood, your outfit, and your aesthetic. So, we decided to warp the rules.

Our Philosophy

We don't do mass-produced, basic designs. Our collection is carefully curated for the bold, the expressive, and the design-obsessed. From sleek, muted tones to vibrant, trend-driven illustrations, every single piece is treated like a work of wearable art.

Because your phone isn't just gear—it’s an accessory.

The Details Matter

Matte or Glossy? You Choose.

We are obsessed with the finer details. That’s why every single one of our premium cases comes in two distinct, high-quality finishes to perfectly fit your tactile vibe:

  • The Velvet Matte: Smooth, zero-reflection, and soft to the touch for a sleek, minimalist look.

  • The Mirror Glossy: Brilliant, light-catching, and vibrant to make our custom artwork truly pop.

Packed with heavy-duty impact protection, our cases are engineered to absorb the drops of everyday life without adding unnecessary bulk to your silhouette.

Corporate Directory

Wired & Warped is an official trading brand proudly owned and operated by Aura Group Ventures Limited.
